verdict.rationale: The evidence covers setup steps, endpoint configuration, editable prompts, run replay and trace export, and a BLE board test script. Nothing in the pack documents an interactive API reference or runnable examples, and the probe for a markdown docs page returned 404. An open-source agent project could plausibly publish such a reference, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence it does.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
